body_ar:
نصرة القضايا الإسلامية كيف يساعد المسلم اليوم في نصرة القضايا الإسلامية؟

إن الله تعالى يبتلي الناس بهذه القضايا، فمن كان منهم مدعيا أنه من أنصار الله وأنه مستجيب لنداء الله إذ قال: {يا أيها الذين آمنوا كونوا أنصارا لله كما قال عيسى ابن مريم للحواريين من أنصاري إلى الله قال الحواريون نحن أنصار الله} فعليه أن يبادر لنصرة الله وليعلم أنها فرصة أتيحت له، وأن الله غني عنه وعن نصرته وقد قال: {ذلك ولو يشاء الله لانتصر منهم ولكن ليبلو بعضكم ببعض}.

----------------------------------------------------------------------

الكلام على مسألة الحجاب في فرنسا

ما هي وجهة نظركم في مسألة الحجاب في فرنسا؟

لا يستغرب من الكفار أن يعادوا الله سبحانه وتعالى وأن يمنعوا تطبيق شرعه وأن يمنعوا امتثال ما أمر به وأمر به رسوله صلى الله عليه وسلم، إنما يستغرب ذلك من المسلمين وقد سبقهم المسلمون إلى هذا، فكثير من البلدان الإسلامية منع فيها الحجاب قبل فترة طويلة، فإذن الفرنسيون جاءوا متأخرين إلى هذه الخطوة فقد سبقهم إليها كثير من البلدان الأخرى، ومع ذلك فهذا كله امتحان من الله تعالى يمتحن به المؤمنين في تلك الدار..
body_en:
Supporting the Causes of Islam

Question: How can a Muslim today help in supporting the causes of Islam?

Answer: God, be He exalted, tests people by means of these causes. So whoever among them claims to be one of the helpers of God, and to be answering the call of God when He said: {O you who believe, be helpers of God, as Jesus son of Mary said to the disciples, "Who are my helpers unto God?" The disciples said, "We are the helpers of God"} (Sūrat al-Ṣaff 61:14) — he must hasten to the help of God, and let him know that it is an opportunity that has been made available to him, and that God has no need of him nor of his help; for He has said: {That [is so]; and had God willed, He would Himself have exacted retribution from them, but [it is] so that He may test some of you by means of others} (Sūrat Muḥammad 47:4).

----------------------------------------------------------------------

On the Question of the Headscarf in France

Question: What is your view on the question of the headscarf in France?

Answer: It is not to be wondered at that the unbelievers should show enmity to God, glorified and exalted, and should prevent the application of His law, and prevent compliance with what He has commanded and what His Messenger (may God bless him and grant him peace) has commanded. What is to be wondered at is that this should come from Muslims — and the Muslims preceded them in it, for in many Muslim countries the headscarf was banned a long while ago. So the French have come late to this step; many other countries preceded them to it. Even so, all of this is a test from God, be He exalted, by which He tests the believers in that land..

flags.note: EDITORIAL REVIEW REQUIRED (house rule 12). Read in English out of context this answer characterises non-Muslims as 'the unbelievers' (al-kuffār) who are expected to show enmity to God, and its substantive point — that Muslim-majority states banned the headscarf first and that France is merely late to it — is a criticism of those states. The answer has been translated faithfully and neither softened nor strengthened. Whether and how it is published is for Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office to decide, not the translator. Note also that it is a 2010 answer to a question about a then-current French controversy, and it carries no date-stamp of its own in the body.
